newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN DOLLAR DOWN, BONDS RISE ON WAGES DATA.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN DOLLAR DOWN, BONDS RISE ON WAGES DATA.

text.p: The Australian dollar eased and bonds firmed after final second quarter average weekly earnings annual growth was revised down to 3.5 percent from a preliminary 3.7 percent.
Private sector earnings fell by 0.1 percent in the three months to May to be 2.5 percent higher over the year compared to 3.6 percent in the previous quarter.

The local dollar was at US$0.7448/53 at 0138 GMT compared with US$0.7453/58 just before the data was released at 0130 GMT, while the September 10-year bond futures contract was 93.340 against a pre-data 93.310.
September bill futures also rose, moving to 95.12 from 95.09.
